text: It's made communication faster and more global, which is undeniably useful. You can message a friend on another continent in seconds. The flip side is that a lot of interaction has become shallow, with people liking each other's posts instead of actually talking. I've noticed that friends sitting at the same table often end up scrolling on their phones. So we're more connected in quantity, but not always in quality.

tips.en: Contrasting quantity and quality makes a compact conclusion.
tips.kk: Сан мен сапаны қарама-қарсы қою — қысқа әрі мәнді қорытынды.
tips.ru: Противопоставление количества и качества — ёмкий вывод.
tips.example: So we're more connected in quantity, but not always in quality

tips.en: An adverb with an adjective strengthens the evaluation concisely.
tips.kk: Үстеу мен сын есім артық сөзсіз бағаны күшейтеді.
tips.ru: Наречие с прилагательным усиливает оценку без лишних слов.

note.en: clearly useful, no one can deny it

note.ru: по количеству, но не всегда по качеству

phrases.text: in quantity, but not always in quality

questions.question: How has social media changed the way people communicate?

text: In a way, yes, particularly over younger audiences. Teenagers often trust influencers more than traditional experts, so a single post can shape what they buy or even how they see themselves. The trouble is that many of these endorsements are paid, and viewers don't always realise it. I'd like to see stricter transparency rules so audiences know when they're being marketed to.

tips.en: 'In a way, yes' gives partial agreement and sounds natural.
tips.kk: «In a way, yes» ішінара келісімді білдіріп, табиғи естіледі.
tips.ru: «In a way, yes» даёт частичное согласие и звучит естественно.
tips.example: In a way, yes, particularly over younger audiences

tips.en: Naming the problem and then a solution completes the thought.
tips.kk: Мәселені атап, шешім ұсыну ойды аяқтайды.
tips.ru: Назвав проблему, вы предлагаете решение — это завершает мысль.
tips.example: The trouble is that many of these endorsements are paid, and viewers don't always realise it

note.en: Partly, from one point of view
rules requiring openness about paid content

questions.question: Do you think social media influencers have too much power?

text: I think some restrictions are sensible, since young children aren't mature enough to handle online pressure or cyberbullying. Setting a minimum age, perhaps thirteen or fourteen, seems reasonable. But an outright ban would be hard to enforce, as kids can easily get around it. A better approach, in my view, is for parents and schools to teach digital literacy, so children learn to use these platforms responsibly rather than just being kept away from them.

tips.en: An objection to a total ban makes the position thoughtful.
tips.kk: Толық тыйымға қарсы дәлел ұстанымды ойлы етеді.
tips.ru: Возражение против полного запрета делает позицию продуманной.
tips.example: But an outright ban would be hard to enforce, as kids can easily get around it

tips.en: A 'so' purpose clause and a passive after 'rather than' add grammatical complexity.
tips.kk: «so» мақсаты және «rather than» кейінгі ырықсыз етіс грамматиканы күрделендіреді.
tips.ru: Цель с «so» и пассив после «rather than» повышают грамматическую сложность.
tips.example: so children learn to use these platforms responsibly rather than just being kept away from them

note.en: to avoid a rule or limit
the skills to use technology safely

questions.followUp: At what age is it appropriate?
questions.question: Should children be restricted from using social media?

text: Probably, although it'll look very different from today. Platforms rise and fall quickly, as MySpace showed, but the underlying need to share and connect isn't going anywhere. I imagine we'll see more immersive experiences, such as virtual reality spaces where you can hang out with friends as avatars. Whether that'll be healthy is another question entirely, but I doubt people will give up online socialising altogether.

tips.en: 'Probably, although' gives a qualified answer, ideal for predictions.
tips.kk: «Probably, although» ескертпелі жауап береді — болжамға лайық.
tips.ru: «Probably, although» даёт ответ с оговоркой — подходит для прогнозов.
tips.example: Probably, although it'll look very different from today

tips.en: Modern terms show knowledge of the topic.

note.en: to spend relaxed time with friends
